legalEntitlement: Loi 1.334 art 11: the schooling duty is met in the ordinary setting, or failing that specially
Special education is set by the child's own particular needs, in specialised services
Each such child gets a regular evaluation of competences, needs and the measures in their path
The commission medico-pedagogique does that evaluation, and the child and parents are heard
On disagreement parents ask the director to reverse his decision (Loi 1.334 art 25)

evidence.bullet: Loi 1.334 art 11: the schooling duty is met in the ordinary setting, or failing that specially
evidence.quote: Il est satisfait à l'obligation scolaire des enfants et des adolescents présentant un handicap ou un trouble de la santé invalidant en leur donnant une éducation en milieu scolaire ordinaire

evidence.bullet: Special education is set by the child's own particular needs, in specialised services
evidence.quote: une éducation spéciale déterminée en fonction de leurs besoins particuliers au sein d'établissements ou services de santé, médico-sociaux ou spécialisés

evidence.bullet: Each such child gets a regular evaluation of competences, needs and the measures in their path
evidence.quote: fait l'objet d'une évaluation régulière de ses compétences, de ses besoins et des mesures mises en oeuvre dans le cadre de son parcours

evidence.bullet: The commission medico-pedagogique does that evaluation, and the child and parents are heard
evidence.quote: Cette évaluation est réalisée par la commission médico-pédagogique mentionnée à l'article 25

evidence.bullet: On disagreement parents ask the director to reverse his decision (Loi 1.334 art 25)
evidence.quote: Les propositions de la commission sont transmises au directeur de l'éducation nationale qui statue

sources.label: Loi n° 1.334 du 12 juillet 2007 sur l'éducation (Monaco), arts. 11 and 25 and the individual-evaluation article — Journal de Monaco no. 7817. The Act's full text, recorded on this entry as not retrieved, serves from journaldemonaco.gouv.mc at HTTP 200

legalEntitlement: The instrument is 05-071 Chapter 101, the Maine Unified Special Education Regulation
Every school administrative unit taking federal or State funds must comply with IDEA
That duty runs to children from birth to twenty-two, under 20-A MRSA s.7006
Speech or language impairment is a named category, covering stuttering and language impairment
It qualifies only where it adversely affects the child's educational performance

evidence.bullet: The instrument is 05-071 Chapter 101, the Maine Unified Special Education Regulation
evidence.quote: Chapter 101, Maine Unified Special Education Regulation

evidence.bullet: Every school administrative unit taking federal or State funds must comply with IDEA
evidence.quote: every school administrative unit, intermediate educational unit, public school, or other public agency that receives federal or State funds

evidence.bullet: That duty runs to children from birth to twenty-two, under 20-A MRSA s.7006
evidence.quote: free appropriate public education services to children age birth to twenty-two with disabilities

evidence.bullet: Speech or language impairment is a named category, covering stuttering and language impairment
evidence.quote: Speech or language impairment means a communication disorder such as stuttering, impaired articulation, a language impairment, or a voice impairment

evidence.bullet: It qualifies only where it adversely affects the child's educational performance
evidence.quote: that adversely affects the child's educational performance
